source.author: Kenney
source.note: Substitutes for the plan's Quaternius radio (poly.pizza static GLB, blocked by a Cloudflare challenge). Kenney Furniture Kit 2.0 `radio` (GLB, the kit's only radio): a portable transistor radio with a rounded case, a carry handle, a recessed front panel and a tuning-dial slot with two knobs. Not kept at the kit's own scale (0.384 kit units = 0.74 m, as sofa, TV and fridge): that makes it 0.61 m wide and 0.44 m tall, a radio twice life size next to the TV. Scaled to a real tabletop radio instead: 0.24 m tall to the top of the handle, 0.33 m wide, 0.10 m deep. A debug render placed the source materials: the case and the two knobs are `wood`, the front panel, the handle and a small bar on top `metalMedium`, the dial slot `metal`. The case takes the script's red (`accent`) with the dark brown (`iris`) shade, lighter than ink, so the shaded back and front rim stay distinct from the outline; the front panel and handle the pale paper pair (practical, sky shade), standing in for the speaker cloth (the model has no grille geometry); the dial slot is `iris` in one tone, so the red knobs sit on a dark strip. Front (panel) faces +Z. Static, no clips.
